**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, the Board of Supervisors approved a 500-megawatt solar project while delaying a decision on a related battery storage facility amid water supply concerns. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area. In the region, a Buchanan County man received two consecutive life sentences plus three years for the 2022 first-degree murder of his pregnant girlfriend and her unborn child; local high school football teams including Bluefield, Independence, and Graham advanced in playoffs.[[1]](https://www.25newsnow.com/video/2026/11/20/tazewell-county-approves-500-megawatt-solar-project-delays-decision-battery-storage-facility/)[[2]](https://www.wjhl.com/news/crime/buchanan-co-man-sentenced-to-2-life-sentences-for-murder-of-pregnant-girlfriend/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Buchanan County, Va. — Dustin Owens was sentenced to two consecutive life sentences plus three years after conviction on charges including first-degree murder of his pregnant girlfriend Amber Dawn Compton (seven months pregnant) and murder of an unborn child in the October 2022 case. The jury convicted him after a nine-day trial in September; Judge Reece Hale Robertson called the crimes “the most horrific and depraved.” This marks the first such conviction under Virginia’s unborn child murder statute in Buchanan County. (Nov. 20, 2026)[[2]](https://www.wjhl.com/news/crime/buchanan-co-man-sentenced-to-2-life-sentences-for-murder-of-pregnant-girlfriend/)

**Core:** Tazewell County Board of Supervisors approved a 500-megawatt solar energy project on Nov. 19, 2026, while postponing action on a separate battery storage facility due to concerns over potential impacts on nearby water supplies.[[1]](https://www.25newsnow.com/video/2026/11/20/tazewell-county-approves-500-megawatt-solar-project-delays-decision-battery-storage-facility/)[[5]](https://www.25newsnow.com/news/tazewell-county/)
